properties.name: B1135/26 / SCVM
properties.originalText:
A/G FAC LTD, DUE TO RDO RECEPTION PROBLEMS, ACFT THAT NEEDS TO
TRANSIT THROUGH RESTRICTED AREAS SC-R67, SC-R35, SC-R1 MUST CONTACT
VINA DEL MAR APP 129.3MHZ TO OBTAIN AUTH. IF NOT ABLE RDO CTC,
THE AREA MUST BE CIRCUMNAVIGATED OR OVF UNTIL AUTH IS OBTAINED
FREQ ALTN 118.9MHZ)
